item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 16/Jan/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A strong northeast monsoon will affect the coast of southern China today and tomorrow. It will be windy over the region. With the monsoon moderating in the latter part of this week, temperatures over Guangdong will rise slightly and the weather will be warm during the day. A cold front is expected to move across southern China over the weekend. The associated intense winter monsoon will affect the region in the following few days. It will become cold appreciably.
